$comment: Benchmark settings. Model IDs and prices were checked against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-11-16; run `pnpm bench:models` to check them again. Prices are USD per million tokens.

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as Anthropic's flagship model; Claude Fable 5.2 is listed as more capable but costs twice as much.

models.label: GPT-6 Astra
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as OpenAI's flagship; GPT-6.1 Sol is newer but is positioned below it.

models.label: Gemini 4 Argon
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as Google's flagship reasoning model.

models.label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
models.why: OpenRouter describes it as Moonshot AI's flagship open-weight model, and its weights are on Hugging Face (moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro).

estimate.$comment: Assumptions used only for the cost estimate printed before a run. Output tokens include hidden reasoning tokens, which most of these models bill as output.
